description: This file defines the 'CookieJar' class which manages HTTP cookies, including storing, retrieving, filtering, and manipulating cookie data within a PHP HTTP client context.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of cookies, allowing for operations such as addition, removal, filtering, and retrieval based on various criteria.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CookieJar with optional strict mode and an initial array of cookies.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar instance populated with cookies from an associative array for a specific domain.

methods.name: shouldPersist
methods.description: Determines whether a given cookie should be persisted based on its attributes and session policies.

methods.name: getCookieByName
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie by its name from the jar.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports the cookies in the jar to an array format.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies matching specified domain, path, and name criteria.

methods.name: clearSessionCookies
methods.description: Removes all session cookies from the jar.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar, replacing existing cookies if necessary, based on validation and conflicts.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of cookies in the jar.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from an HTTP response and associates them with a request context.

methods.name: getCookiePathFromRequest
methods.description: Computes applicable cookie path for a request following RFC 6265.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Adds appropriate Cookie headers to a request based on stored cookies.

methods.name: removeCookieIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes a cookie from the jar if its value is null or empty.
